definitions.explanation: The money a company spends on advertising, treated as a cost item in accounting and business planning.

examples.japanese: {広告費|こうこくひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削|けず}る→削る：03922_kezuru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: We decided to cut advertising expenses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今期|こんき}→今期：29530_konki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{広告費|こうこくひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一割|いちわり}→一割：26078_ichiwari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}めた→占める：11799_shimeru⟧。
examples.english: This term, advertising expenses accounted for ten percent of sales.

examples.japanese: ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{広告費|こうこくひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{移|うつ}した→移す：10122_utsusu⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、{若|わか}い{客層|きゃくそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of shifting the ad spend from television to the internet, the customer base grew younger.

notes:
⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧ (advertisement) + ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (expense). Part of the standard family of business cost words formed with ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧, alongside ⟦{人件費|じんけんひ}→人件費：20616_jinkenhi⟧ and ⟦{交通費|こうつうひ}→交通費：03056_koutsuuhi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {広告費|こうこくひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}する→削減する：25399_sakugensuru⟧: to cut advertising expenses
- {広告費|こうこくひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to spend money on advertising
- {広告費|こうこくひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧: the advertising budget

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{宣伝費|せんでんひ}→宣伝費：30168_sendenhi⟧: publicity expenses — nearly synonymous; covers promotion beyond paid ads
- ⟦{販促費|はんそくひ}→販促費：30184_hansokuhi⟧: sales promotion expenses — campaigns and giveaways rather than media buying
